description: Gray water container reached capacity with a 7-person crew — more than the standard container holds.
response: The Logistics Officer found a disassembled wheelbarrow under the hab and fashioned it into a second reservoir, which the Health and Safety Officer used to displace the excess gray water for the rest of the mission. Disposal (in case it doesn't evaporate over winter) was left as an open question for the next crew.
lesson: For crews of 5+, plan secondary gray water storage in advance. Consider bringing a dedicated collapsible container.
